input.text:
Size should not equal excitement.

When emotions run high, it is easy to make the trade bigger just because it feels important.

Marcus’ reminder: decide the position size before the noise starts. The setup can be valid and still be too large for your headspace.

Smaller can be stronger when it helps you follow the plan.

Educational content only. Not financial advice.
